# Dr. Nihar Modi - Orthopaedic Surgeon

## About
Dr. Nihar Modi is a highly qualified Orthopaedic Surgeon practicing in Bandra, Mumbai. He specializes in Sports Medicine (Sports Orthopaedic Surgeon), Arthroscopy, and Arthroplasty (Joint Replacement). He is dedicated to providing advanced care for shoulder, elbow, and knee injuries.

## Specialties
- Sports Medicine & Sports Injuries
- Arthroscopic Surgeries (Keyhole Surgery)
- Arthroplasty (Joint Replacement)
- Trauma & Fracture Management
- Shoulder, Elbow, and Knee treatments

## Qualifications
- **Fellowships**: 
  - Clinical Fellowship in Shoulder, Elbow and Knee Sports Medicine, Arthroscopy and Arthroplasty (Orthoclinic, Australian Orthopaedic Association (AOA), Sydney, Australia)
  - Clinical Observership in Paediatric Sports Injuries and Musculoskeletal Trauma (Ascension Sacred Heart Hospital, Florida, USA)
  - Clinical Fellowship in Arthroscopy, Sports Medicine and Shoulder Arthroplasty (Mumbai, India)
- **MRCS**: Royal College of Surgeons, England
- **Diploma**: FIFA Diploma in Football Medicine
- **M.N.A.M.S**: National Academy of Medical Sciences, India
- **D.N.B. Orthopaedics**: Delhi National Board, India
- **M.S. Orthopaedics**: Maharashtra University of Health Sciences, Grant Medical College and Sir JJ Group of Hospitals, Mumbai, India
- **M.B.B.S.**: Topiwala National Medical College and BYL Nair Charitable Hospital, Mumbai, India

## Clinic Location
Practicing in Bandra / Khar, Mumbai, India.

## Professional Memberships
- Bombay Orthopaedic Society
- Indian Arthroscopy Society
